purpose: Define the matching single-process CPU repeated-eval baseline for the VeeR-EL2 resident workload shapes before throughput comparison.
preconditions: VeeR-EL2 host probe is available after the bounded asset boundary is copied
reports/veer_el2_resident_workload_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time for VeeR-EL2 at the defined resident workload shapes
GPU resident-step throughput for VeeR-EL2 at the same gate shapes after the GPU gate passes
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for the bounded VeeR-EL2 resident candidate
non_claims: not proof of broad VeeR family support
not a full RTL application throughput claim
not a resident patch/script semantics claim
